author: Tonda
changelog: Auto DJ: tap a mood for a DJ set of that mood, DJ the artist playing, or Start Auto DJ for a mix built from the songs you finish most. When a set ends, Auto DJ starts a fresh one by itself (turn it off in settings). DJ Culture is now Auto DJ.
description: Culture — low-data listening for Myspoti: tiny audio first, unstoppable playback, small downloads for offline, a data meter, Smart Shuffle, Moods, AutoMix and Auto DJ.
name: Culture

settings.description: Smallest uses the tiniest files, including free copies. Balanced uses your folder only. Best steps aside and lets Spotify play full quality.
settings.label: Lite quality

settings.description: Optional. A web folder of your own MP3s with an index.json (see README). Songs found here play small and download for offline.
settings.label: Your own music folder URL

settings.description: Also look for a free legal copy on Archive.org when your folder has nothing.
settings.label: Try free copies too

settings.description: Never play a song twice until every song in the list has played once.
settings.label: Smart Shuffle: no repeats

settings.description: Order shuffles like a DJ set: calm songs first, building to high energy, instead of jumping around at random. Off is a plain random shuffle.
settings.label: AutoMix

settings.description: When a DJ set ends, start a fresh mix by itself, like Spotify autoplay. Off: the DJ stops at the end of the set.
settings.label: Auto DJ: keep playing

welcome.message: Culture plays small files first so songs use little data, resolves the next song early so it never stops, downloads small files for offline, shuffles without repeats, sorts Liked Songs into Moods, mixes them with AutoMix, and Auto DJ plays a set of what you ask for or what you always like.
steps: In Myspoti, put Culture above Spotify in Settings, Playback (audio) and Downloads.
Set Downloads quality to Small for the tiniest offline files.
Turn on Myspoti's own Data Saver and Low quality for Spotify streams.
Tap a mood on Home, Start Auto DJ for a mix of what you like, or DJ the artist playing.
Optional: add your own music folder URL in the extension settings.
